# Welcome {.unnumbered}

*Graphics Support in SO3* is the English edition of my Bachelor thesis *Support graphique dans SO3*, written at HEIG-VD from February to July 2020 under the supervision of Prof. Daniel Rossier.

The thesis adds graphics and input device support to SO3, a lightweight operating system developed by the REDS institute, then brings that support to SOO Mobile Entities, first in QEMU and then on a Raspberry Pi 4. Along the way it integrates the LittlevGL graphics library, writes framebuffer, mouse and keyboard drivers, adds device files and `mmap` to SO3, and builds the virtual framebuffer and input interfaces a Mobile Entity needs to reach the screen from inside SOO.

This edition is translated from the original French and revised: the text has been edited for clarity, code excerpts have been corrected where needed, and the diagrams have been redrawn. It has also been checked against the original commits, the weekly meeting minutes and the forum posts written during the thesis, which led to a few factual corrections and to explanations the original left out. This check was done with the help of an AI model, as @sec-revision explains. The original LaTeX and Sphinx versions live in [nyg/so3-support-graphique](https://gitlab.com/nyg/so3-support-graphique), and the code in [smartobjectoriented/so3](https://github.com/smartobjectoriented/so3) and [smartobjectoriented/soo](https://github.com/smartobjectoriented/soo).
